story:
Ethan had been building a red, three-level rocket track for his toy cars all morning. The tall, winding ramps were almost finished — but one silver piece was missing from the very top.

"I think it rolled under the chair," said his neighbor, Marcus, who had just arrived. [emotion:QT/happy] Marcus was clever and cheerful, and Ethan felt relieved because searching alone had felt frustrating. [emotion:QT/calm] "I'll check the dark corner while you hold the ramp steady," Marcus suggested.

Although the gap was small, Marcus reached in and found the piece. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan gave a huge grin because that tiny part had made everything feel impossible before.

After Marcus snapped it in, they took turns releasing the cars. A chunky blue racer flew down so fast it went skidding right off the table, and both boys burst out laughing. [emotion:QT/happy] [emotion:QT/happy] "We built something really great together," Ethan said, feeling proud as the cars raced past the finish line. [gesture:clapping]

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his rocket track?
questions.correct_answer: Working together as a team makes things easier and more fun
wrong_answers: Racing toy cars is better than building tracks
It is important to find every missing piece yourself

questions.question: After Marcus arrived, where did he think the missing silver piece had rolled?
questions.correct_answer: Under the chair in a dark corner
wrong_answers: Behind the three-level rocket track ramp
Underneath the chunky blue racer car

questions.question: What happened right after Marcus snapped the missing piece into the rocket track?
questions.correct_answer: They took turns releasing the cars down the ramps
wrong_answers: They went outside to race their cars on the street
Ethan rebuilt the three ramps from the very bottom

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt relieved when Marcus arrived to help him with the rocket track?
questions.correct_answer: Because searching alone had felt really frustrating
wrong_answers: Because Marcus brought three new toy cars with him
Because Ethan was tired and wanted to stop building

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Marcus had not reached into the dark corner to find the missing piece?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan might not have finished the rocket track at all
wrong_answers: The chunky blue racer would have gone faster down the ramp
Ethan would have found three more silver pieces right away

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to let Marcus help him find the missing piece?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help makes hard things easier.
wrong_answers: Letting someone else do all the work means you finish faster.
Having a friend nearby means you never have to look for things yourself.

questions.question: What can we do like Ethan and Marcus when we play with something together?
questions.correct_answer: Taking turns makes working together more fun for everyone.
wrong_answers: Sharing your favorite toys means you will always get them back.
Playing with a friend means someone else can fix your mistakes.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Keeping on trying, even when something feels hard, leads to something great.
wrong_answers: Building things on your own is the best way to feel proud of your work.
Finishing a project quickly is more important than enjoying the steps along the way.

takeaways: Asking a friend for help makes hard things easier.
Taking turns makes working together more fun for everyone.
Keeping on trying, even when something feels hard, leads to something great.
